description:
A single published figure, or a published range [low, high].

Storage never collapses a range: no midpoint, and never an average of two publishers. `low` is the figure its source stands behind, `high` the widest count any source supports, and both travel to the renderer so a caption can print the range a chart can only hint at.

`midOf()` below does collapse, for plotting. The rule is about storage: anything that quotes a number rather than drawing one must read the band.
